name: gameanything
description: Turn your memories (wedding, trip, photos) into playable content inside a game you own. Guides the agent through the whole GameAnything workflow with the gameanything CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your memories into a playable game world
interface.longDescription: Guides the agent through ingesting your photos and videos locally, confirming people and the day with you in a browser UI, and building the result into your own copy of Stardew Valley.
defaultPrompt: Turn my wedding photos into a Stardew Valley mod
